subject: Self-service password reset required
body: Our HR system has migrated to a new self-service portal and all employee accounts must be re-verified. Please follow the steps in the portal to set your new password and confirm your recovery email. Your current password will no longer be accepted after the migration window closes. If you experience any issues, use the self-service reset option rather than contacting support, as support volume is limited during migration.
indicators: asks you to re-enter password in a new portal
hook: A system-migration story makes re-entering credentials seem like a normal step.
